whatIsIt.eli5: Blurs a tiny bit, then makes the picture smaller.
whatIsIt.simple: YOLOv9's simple downsampling: 2×2 average pooling (stride 1), then a 3×3 stride-2 Conv.

whyExists.eli5: A small blur before shrinking loses less.
whyExists.simple: Used in the small YOLOv9 models (t, s) instead of ADown.

example.eli5: YOLOv9t uses it to go from 160 to 80.
